name: Air circuit breaker
summary: An ACB is a low-voltage circuit breaker using air as its interrupting medium.
description: An ACB is a low-voltage circuit breaker using air as its interrupting medium. It is frequently used for main incomers or bus couplers and may be fixed or withdrawable.
